: cmux-antigravity-hook-v2; :; printenv CMUX_ANTIGRAVITY_HOOKS_DISABLED | grep -qx 1 && { :; { cat >/dev/null 2>/dev/null || true; echo '{}'; }; } || { cmux_hook_ambient_socket=$(printenv CMUX_SOCKET_PATH || printf '\n'; printf '.'); cmux_hook_ambient_socket=${cmux_hook_ambient_socket%??}; cmux_hook_ambient_cli=$(printenv CMUX_BUNDLED_CLI_PATH || printf '\n'; printf '.'); cmux_hook_ambient_cli=${cmux_hook_ambient_cli%??}; if [ -n "${cmux_hook_ambient_socket:-}" ] && [ -S "${cmux_hook_ambient_socket:-}" ] && [ -f "${cmux_hook_ambient_cli:-}" ] && [ -x "${cmux_hook_ambient_cli:-}" ] && CMUXTERM_CLI_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_SEC=0.5 "${cmux_hook_ambient_cli:-}" --socket "${cmux_hook_ambient_socket:-}" hooks enqueue antigravity <EVENT>; then :; elif [ -x '/Applications/cmux.app/Contents/Resources/bin/cmux' ]; then CMUXTERM_CLI_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_SEC=0.5 '/Applications/cmux.app/Contents/Resources/bin/cmux' --socket '<SOCK>' hooks enqueue antigravity <EVENT>; elif command -v cmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then CMUXTERM_CLI_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_SEC=0.5 cmux --socket '<SOCK>' hooks enqueue antigravity <EVENT>; else { cat >/dev/null 2>/dev/null || true; echo '{}'; }; fi; cmux_hook_status=$?; :; if [ "$cmux_hook_status" -ne 0 ]; then { cat >/dev/null 2>/dev/null || true; echo '{}'; }; fi; exit 0; }
